name: Weldon Library
summary: Board-formed concrete building featuring L-shaped upper stacks above a wide low podium, deep horizontal window slots below a cantilever, broad entrance steps, and a blank southern archive.

evidence.note: Facilities Management photograph of the exterior and its openings.
Inventory core-1m surface percentiles above ground: median 11.23 m, 90th percentile 25.91 m, maximum 30.8 m.
Southwest elevation shows continuous recessed glazing, broad spandrels, blade piers and a deep upper overhang. Lower row has angled glazing caps.
End of the window run meets a blind vertically textured concrete core.
View across parking toward the southern archive shows large blind panel fields separated by narrow raised vertical joints. Index 3 is the frame matcher target, not the entire visible face.
Library master plan identifies an L-shaped upper stack over large lower floorplates and a double-height entrance hall.
Entrance positions are aligned to mapped footpath, service or stair endpoints where those meet the outer wall. Door and step dimensions are estimates.
2025 aerial shows a rotated rectangular southern archive, stepped stack roofs to the northwest, a low staggered eastern perimeter and a square skylight.
Bay counts, opening dimensions and storey heights on unseen elevations are architectural estimates. Wall and roof hues are image samples, subject to exposure and shadows.
PIL mean patches for wall and trim centred at (95%, 37%) and (81%, 78%) of the photo. Exposure multipliers 1 and 1 approximate daylight across the source views.

The 1 m roof grid traces two orthogonal upper-stack legs with field elevations near 23.6 m, an inner L-shaped strip near 26.1 m and a rooftop service volume near 29.7 m. Point (74, 368) falls on that inner strip. The archive roof at (108, 426) is about 9.1 m.
Frame 73870297 shows narrow bronze glazing behind deep concrete piers between fluted end cores. Ground-floor window caps incline toward the wall.

At (74,368) the ridge is 26.14 m. Its inner flank falls first to about 19 m and then to the 15.4 m reading-room roof. The north podium returns near 9.3 m. The archive at (108,426) stays near 9.1 m. Near (140,380) the east recess returns to grade.

notes: The concrete soffit is deeply coffered. No street view resolves the eastern podium entrance glazing.
